steps: Animals may overlap mountain (only some animals are rivers)
check_code:
import itertools
types=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4)) # river,mountain,animal,bird
always=[True,True]
for n in range(1,5):
    for pop in itertools.combinations(types,n):
        if any(t[0] and t[1] for t in pop):continue
        if not any(t[0] and t[2] for t in pop):continue
        if not any(t[3] and t[1] for t in pop):continue
        c1=not any(t[2] and t[1] for t in pop)
        c2=not any(t[0] and t[3] for t in pop)
        always=[always[0] and c1,always[1] and c2]
assert always==[False,False]
opts={'A':(1,1),'B':(0,0),'C':(1,0),'D':(0,1)}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if list(map(bool,v))==always]==['B']
